set.body: PLS Neuro native fixture /private/tmp/plsneuro-bilateral-ui.log fails visible surface acceptance with left mesh near x0 and right display mesh near x100. SurfaceCompiler centers each bilateral slot but uses the uncentered union radius for camera distance, shrinking both meshes. Fix general bilateral framing in surface-view; verify translation-invariant size, both orders, single-surface regression and JVM/JS suites, then downstream JavaFX fixture.
set.title: Bilateral camera radius must use centered slot extents
